claim_boundary: This disposition closes the unexecuted four-molecule preregistration after independent scientific review found that its Route-1, QM, and experimental evidence chain was not complete enough to audit the proposed gates. It records no energy result and does not alter the locked panel, profile, thresholds, or execution budget.
decision_reasons: Existing QM references were not locked per molecule with tracked artifact path, SHA256, energy, geometry hash, charge, multiplicity, and runtime protocol.
The Route-1 control did not lock per-molecule source-record SHA256, prediction, and source MOL2 SHA256 even though those records existed read-only.
The experimental block did not lock the FreeSolv dataset commit, artifact hashes, record SHA256, DOI, and assigned uncertainty.
The requested next benchmark program is broader than this oxygen-rich four-molecule diagnostic and requires a new provenance-complete preregistration rather than post-registration edits.
replacement_requirement: Any replacement must lock dataset/version/record provenance, identical geometry evidence for every compared method, charge-model and continuum-method identity, per-solvent experimental references, immutable thresholds, and a staged evaluation budget before execution.
